paths:

<!-- Generated by `bdk rules export --claude` from .bdk/rules/. Do not edit: change the rule files and rerun it. -->

- [PROMPTS-1] Give the model the whole task up front (goal, constraints, when it is done) instead of a numbered step script; the kernel holds the order. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [PROMPTS-2] Write no "double-check" or "verify before finishing" sentence; name the command that decides, such as `bdk attempt close`, instead. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [PROMPTS-3] Name the early stop to avoid, a turn that ends by announcing its next step, and say which stops are wanted. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [PROMPTS-4] Ask a reviewer for every finding with its severity and category, never only the important ones; the blocking categories and the kernel decide what blocks. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [PROMPTS-5] Show the wanted form once as a positive example instead of listing prohibitions, and write without capitals for emphasis. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [SKILLS-1] A skill writes under `.bdk/` only through `bdk` commands and never creates a directory of its own there. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [SKILLS-2] A skill that starts a role agent passes the package path from `bdk dispatch build`, never a resolved command, because the kernel puts the project's `tools.*` commands into the package. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [SKILLS-3] A skill whose job is discovering the stack, such as `setup`, names runners in its derivation tables by necessity; never rewrite those tables into generic prose. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [SKILLS-4] A skill that only makes sense for one language stack or domain does not belong in `skills/`; it goes into that project's `.claude/`. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [SKILLS-5] A skill directory holds no `fragments/`: conditional content is a part of the skill's entry in `kernel/src/ctx/use-cases/manifest.ts`. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [SKILLS-6] Hook scripts live in `hooks/<hook-name>/`, never in `skills/`, and a skill's own hook never duplicates a global hook of `hooks/hooks.json`. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
- [SKILLS-7] A skill that needs another skill checks for it at start with a `once: true` `UserPromptSubmit` hook running `bdk hooks skill-exists <skill-name>` through the bundle path, with the kernel-unavailable `echo` fallback. (applies: skills/**, agents/**)
